source_owner: Muang Thai Life Assurance Public Company Limited
scope_note: Current merchandising list shown on the official All Insurance page, not a registry of every historical URL or every product currently quotable in every sales channel. Verify channel, version, underwriting and sale status in the company quotation system.
duplicate_note: The Kids Health Insurance card is a segment page for D Health Lite, not a separate policy form.

cards.name: เมืองไทย เฟล็กซี่ โพรเทคชั่น
cards.key_fact: Life cover can be used as IPD/OPD medical benefit from age 65; medical claims reduce the remaining death/maturity benefit.

cards.name: เมืองไทย ไลฟ์ไทม์ โพรเทคชั่น 99/20
cards.key_fact: Combines life cover and staged critical-illness benefits; minimum sum insured shown is THB 150,000.

cards.name: โครงการ เมืองไทย วัยเก๋า อุ่นใจหายห่วง (เพื่อผู้สูงอายุ)
cards.coverage_term: life/fixed health to age 90; PA to age 76
cards.key_fact: Official page says no medical exam and no health questions; combines life, accident and fixed health/daily benefits, not comprehensive medical reimbursement.

cards.name: โครงการ เมืองไทยวัยเก๋า คุ้มทั่วไทย (เพื่อผู้สูงอายุ)
cards.coverage_term: life to age 90; PA to age 76
cards.key_fact: Life and accident package with accident medical and hospital daily benefits; explain first-two-policy-year illness benefit rules.

cards.name: เมืองไทย สมาร์ท โพรเทคชั่น 99/20
cards.key_fact: Long-term life protection with level premium by issue age; riders may be attached subject to rules.

cards.name: เมืองไทย แฮปปี้ รีเทิร์น 99/7
cards.key_fact: Annual cash benefits plus death and maturity benefits according to the policy schedule.

cards.name: ดี เฮลท์ ไลต์
cards.key_fact: THB 1m or 5m per confinement/treatment episode, with deductible or copay choices; ages 30 days-10 years can buy only deductible/copay plans.

cards.name: อีลิท เฮลท์ พลัส
cards.key_fact: Annual limits THB 20m/40m/75m/100m with geographic choices and advanced treatments depending on plan.

cards.name: ประกันสุขภาพเหมาจ่าย เอ็กซ์ตร้า
cards.key_fact: Entry-level first-baht inpatient reimbursement, up to THB 500,000 per inpatient episode depending on plan.

cards.name: โอพีดีต่อครั้ง และ โอพีดีเหมาจ่าย
cards.key_fact: Per-visit THB 500-3,000 up to 30 visits/year, or annual aggregate THB 15,000-100,000, depending on selected rider/plan.

cards.name: เอ็กซ์ตร้าแคร์ พลัส
cards.key_fact: Deductible top-up intended to supplement employer welfare or existing medical cover; up to THB 500,000 depending on plan.

cards.name: ประกันสุขภาพเด็ก (D Health Lite)
cards.key_fact: Child-focused presentation of D Health Lite; not a distinct policy form.
cards.same_product_as: ดี เฮลท์ ไลต์

cards.name: ซีไอ เพอร์เฟค แคร์
cards.key_fact: 36 critical illnesses with benefits across stages and specified complications.

cards.name: มัลติเพิล ซีไอ
cards.key_fact: 35 diseases in four groups; aggregate benefits up to 400% and continued cover for remaining groups for 10 years, subject to terms.

cards.name: ดี แคร์
cards.key_fact: Choose disease groups and stages from six plan configurations.

cards.name: แคร์ พลัส
cards.key_fact: IPD/OPD medical reimbursement for cancer and/or chronic kidney failure, THB 1m or 5m per disease per year depending on plan.

cards.name: สมาร์ท ซิลเวอร์ และ สมาร์ท ซิลเวอร์ พลัส
cards.key_fact: Lump-sum or monthly options for Alzheimer’s, stroke and total permanent disability depending on plan.

cards.name: คิดส์ แคร์
cards.key_fact: Lump-sum cover for 15 serious childhood diseases; not medical reimbursement.

cards.name: เพียว แคนเซอร์ และ สัญญาเพิ่มเติมความคุ้มครองมะเร็ง
cards.key_fact: Pure Cancer provides lump-sum cancer benefits including non-invasive stage under terms; Cancer Rider adds hospital-related benefits.

cards.name: เมืองไทย 9901 ดี65
cards.key_fact: Annual pension of 12% of sum insured under the schedule; minimum sum insured THB 50,000.

cards.name: เฟล็กซี่ รีไทร์ 90/5 ดี55 ดี60 ดี65
cards.key_fact: Start pension at 55, 60 or 65; annual or monthly option and change of start age subject to terms; pension can step up to 24% per year.

cards.name: เมืองไทย สมาร์ท ลิงค์ โปร 10/1 (Global) Index-Linked
cards.key_fact: Scheduled cash benefits plus non-guaranteed upside linked to Citi Global Multi Asset USD VT 5 Series 3 Index.

cards.name: เมืองไทย สมาร์ท อินเด็กซ์ 15/6 (Global) ซีรีส์
cards.key_fact: Guaranteed schedule plus non-guaranteed upside linked to S&P Multi-Asset Global Macro ESG Index.

cards.name: เมืองไทย สมาร์ท อินเด็กซ์ 15/3 (Global)
cards.entry_age: 30 days-80 years on main product page
cards.key_fact: 3% cash benefit every two years under schedule plus non-guaranteed index-linked upside; online-channel version may have different entry ages.

cards.name: เมืองไทย เพอร์เฟค เซฟวิ่ง 11/5
cards.key_fact: Cash benefits every two policy years and maturity benefit; quoted percentage is relative to sum insured, not premium IRR.

cards.name: เมืองไทย ซุปเปอร์ เซฟเวอร์ 25/16
cards.key_fact: Annual cash benefits and life cover up to 150% under the schedule.

cards.name: เมืองไทย อีซี่ แพลน 11/1
cards.key_fact: Scheduled total benefit example up to 112% of sum insured; not equivalent to 112% return on premium.

cards.name: PA Pay Max
cards.key_fact: Accidental death/disability, accident medical and hospital-income package; accidental-death amount up to THB 10m depending on plan.

cards.name: PA Easy Plan Rider
cards.coverage_term: subject to base policy and renewal
cards.key_fact: Seven plans with 24-hour worldwide accident death/disability and medical benefits.

cards.name: PA Take Care
cards.key_fact: Focuses on hospital income after accident; ICU benefit doubles under terms and accidental death up to THB 1m depending on plan.

cards.name: PA Return Cash
cards.key_fact: Accident medical up to THB 100,000 per accident plus income benefit; partial return after three continuous claim-free years under terms.

cards.name: PA Broken Bone
cards.key_fact: Benefits for fracture, burns and internal-organ injury up to THB 200,000 and accident medical up to THB 100,000 depending on plan.

cards.name: PA Go
cards.key_fact: Online basic PA; accidental death up to THB 500,000 and accident medical up to THB 50,000 depending on plan.

cards.name: mDesign
cards.key_fact: Adjustable protection and fund choice; policy value must remain sufficient for insurance and rider charges.

cards.name: mOnePlus
cards.coverage_term: up to age 99 under product page
cards.key_fact: Single-premium protection plus fund investment; withdrawals and market losses can reduce benefits and policy value.

cards.name: mGrow 615
cards.coverage_term: 15 years, extendable to age 99 under conditions
cards.key_fact: Fund selection and 2% bonus at start of policy year 7 under terms; investment risk and charges remain.

cards.name: เมืองไทยยูแอล พลัส
cards.key_fact: Flexible sum assured and premium with minimum credited return under terms; premium holidays or withdrawals can reduce benefits.

cards.name: เมืองไทย SME 20 plus
cards.key_fact: All employees must be covered and enrolled in Social Security under the eligibility shown on the product page.

cards.name: Small Group & Housekeeping Package
cards.group_size: from 2 people under the official page
cards.key_fact: IPD/OPD choices for small groups or household staff, subject to the group table and conditions.

cards.name: โครงการตะกาฟุล เซฟวิ่ง 10/4
cards.key_fact: Hibah and life benefits follow the official certificate schedule.

cards.name: เมืองไทยตะกาฟุลออมทรัพย์ 5/5
cards.key_fact: Life and maturity benefits plus possible special dividend under terms.

cards.name: ตะกาฟุลคุ้มครองตลอดชีพ 95/20
cards.key_fact: Life protection and possible special dividend under the official certificate.

cards.name: PA Takaful Safety
cards.key_fact: 24-hour worldwide accident cover and medical benefit up to THB 100,000 per accident depending on plan.
